subject: AI Systems Builder application — built you a demo
body: Hi! I'm Lena, a full-stack developer based in San Diego. I saw your AI Systems Builder posting and wanted to apply. I've been building AI agents and automation tools independently for the past year — mostly Node.js, Python, and various LLM APIs. I put together a small project as my application: a webhook-based lead scoring pipeline that enriches company data and routes qualified leads to Slack. Repo is at github.com/lenapark/lead-scorer. I'm excited about the venture studio model because I love building across different problem domains. Happy to chat anytime.
